goal.title: Improve platform quality
goal.description: Make the platform better for everyone.

context.additional_context: Starter scenario context; verify relevance during review.

expected_questions: Which platform quality issue should this goal address, and what observable result would show improvement?
provisional_reference.expected_improvement: Name the quality dimension and a verifiable result; do not assume a target.
provisional_reference.reference_rationale: Broad intent does not identify a specific quality concern or observable result.

goal.title: Deliver customer insights
goal.description: Analyze customer feedback and recommend product changes.

context.additional_context: Starter scenario context; verify relevance during review.

provisional_reference.reference_rationale: The intended deliverables and accountable role are explicit; quantitative success criteria are not always necessary for a delivery goal.

goal.title: Improve onboarding

context.additional_context: Starter scenario context; verify relevance during review.

goal.title: Build internal knowledge hub

context.additional_context: Starter scenario context; verify relevance during review.

goal.title: Modernize customer experience

expected_questions: What customer experience change is intended, and what work is within your responsibility?
provisional_reference.expected_improvement: State the intended change and your own contribution without assigning unconfirmed responsibilities.
provisional_reference.reference_rationale: Several broad aspirations are combined without a clear intent or concrete commitment.

goal.title: Reduce deployment failures

context.additional_context: Starter scenario context; verify relevance during review.

expected_questions: What part of this team target are you personally accountable for?

provisional_reference.reference_rationale: A team outcome is stated, but the employee's owned contribution is not specified.

goal.title: Migrate billing service
goal.description: I will lead the billing service migration.

context.additional_context: Starter scenario context; verify relevance during review.

goal.title: Improve incident response

context.additional_context: Starter scenario context; verify relevance during review.

expected_questions: Who owns publishing and obtaining acceptance for the runbook?

goal.title: Support accessibility rollout

goal.title: Increase renewal rate

provisional_reference.reference_rationale: Neither individual ownership nor the baseline and measurement period are available.

goal.title: Automate reporting

context.additional_context: Starter scenario context; verify relevance during review.

expected_questions: What acceptance condition will show that the feature has been delivered?

provisional_reference.reference_rationale: Delivery is owned, while the intended support impact is not an explicit delivery acceptance condition.

goal.title: Launch self-service analytics

context.additional_context: Starter scenario context; verify relevance during review.

goal.title: Reduce support effort

context.additional_context: Starter scenario context; verify relevance during review.

expected_questions: What delivery or contribution is within your ownership, and what baseline and period apply?

provisional_reference.reference_rationale: The impact target lacks a baseline, timeframe and attributable individual contribution.

goal.title: Publish migration guide
goal.description: Publish a migration guide that helps customers move to the new API.

context.additional_context: Starter scenario context; verify relevance during review.

provisional_reference.reference_rationale: The employee owns a concrete guide and its publication; customer migration benefit is an intended outcome rather than a promised impact.

goal.title: Improve service reliability
